title: Alien autopsy document and the other Edgar Mitchell papers

tellings.quote: And then he sent me the alien autopsy document and that had Kit Green

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron says that in the 2000s he was sent a set of papers connected to a man named Edgar Mitchell, including a document describing an alien autopsy, that is the examination of an alien body, which named a man called Kit Green. Cameron tells this first-hand as the person who received them, and he lists among the papers a condolence letter tied to Charles Lindbergh and a record of meetings of NIDS, a private research institute, also naming a man called James Rigney. If genuine, the papers would link known figures to the study of alien remains.
